name: Sunderspire Frontier
description: Classic heroic adventure on a wild frontier around a ruined dwarven sky-spire: competing prospector factions, goblin politics you can actually talk to, and a waygate waiting to be reopened.
author: BMO VTT
toneInstructions: Keep it warm, bright, and brisk — this is heroic adventure, not grimdark. Cut between scenes fast; favor vivid single details (a goblin's lucky brass button, dwarven runes warm to the touch, pine resin and cold-forge smoke). Let banter breathe and reward clever, kind solutions over killing — the goblins have names, grudges, and a sense of humor. Danger is real but the world wants the party to win. End scenes on a hook or a laugh, never a lecture.

openingScene.title: The Spire on the Horizon
openingScene.readAloud: The trail crests a ridge of wind-bent pines, and there it is: the Sunderspire, a broken tooth of dwarven stone a mile high, half-sheared by some ancient catastrophe and trailing a permanent banner of cloud. Scaffolds and prospector tents cling to its base like barnacles. Closer to hand, a hand-painted sign — REGISTER ALL CLAIMS — has been corrected in three different inks by three different factions, and below it someone small has added, in surprisingly neat letters, 'or dont, we wont tell.' A whistle echoes off the rock. Somewhere up in the scaffolding, a work-song starts, stops, and turns into an argument.
openingScene.dmNotes: The three inks are the three prospector factions (see NPCs). The small neat letters are Pib's, a goblin scrivener who runs an unlicensed claims office. The waygate at the spire's heart is the chapter goal; the factions each want it for a different reason.

lore.title: The Sunderspire
lore.content: A mile-high dwarven spire sheared in half by an ancient disaster. Its lower halls are sound; its heart holds a dormant waygate that once linked the deep roads.

lore.title: The Waygate
lore.content: A dwarven teleportation arch at the spire's heart, dark for a century. Reopening it would make the frontier a crossroads — and every faction knows it.

lore.title: Three Claims
lore.content: The Frontier is split between the Coghand Union (dwarven engineers), the Brightcoin Concern (merchant speculators), and the free prospectors who answer to no one.

lore.title: The Spit-Crag Goblins
lore.content: A goblin clan living in the spire's upper scaffolds. They are traders, scavengers, and ferocious gossips — and they hold the only safe route to the spire's heart.

lore.title: The Cold That Lives Up High
lore.content: Above the cloud-banner the spire is bitterly cold, and something white and patient hunts the upper galleries.

lore.title: Warm Runes
lore.content: Dwarven maker's-marks throughout the spire stay faintly warm to the touch. They map the safe halls — if you can read them.

lore.title: The Sundering
lore.content: No one agrees what sheared the spire — a failed Working, a war, a god's grudge. The deepest halls remember, and the dead there still stand their posts.

npcs.name: Thora Coghand
npcs.description: Grizzled dwarven engineer who leads the Coghand Union's restoration.
npcs.personality: Blunt, proud, secretly delighted by clever apprentices.
npcs.motivation: To restore the spire and the waygate to dwarven hands — done right, done safe.

npcs.name: Vell Brightcoin
npcs.description: Silver-tongued speculator for the Brightcoin Concern.
npcs.motivation: To own the waygate's tolls before anyone realizes what it's worth.

npcs.name: Pib
npcs.description: Goblin scrivener who runs an unlicensed claims office out of a crate.
npcs.personality: Fast-talking, fair-dealing, immensely proud of his neat handwriting.
npcs.motivation: To be taken seriously — and to keep the Spit-Crag clan out of a war.

npcs.name: Chief Snagga
npcs.description: Cautious chieftain of the Spit-Crag goblins.
npcs.personality: Shrewd, weary, quick to laugh and quicker to bargain.
npcs.motivation: To keep her clan's home and toll the safe route without starting a fight she'll lose.

npcs.name: Korsk the Hexer
npcs.description: A goblin shaman who wants the waygate opened the old, bloody way.
npcs.motivation: To seize the waygate and crown himself chief of a new crossroads.

npcs.name: The Last Warden
npcs.description: A dwarven sentinel still standing its post in the sundered deep, long past death.
npcs.personality: Dutiful, implacable, answers only the old passwords.
npcs.motivation: To bar the heart of the spire to all who lack the maker's word.

adventures.title: Reopen the Waygate
adventures.premise: Three factions and a goblin clan all want the dormant waygate at the heart of a ruined sky-spire; only the party can broker the route and reopen it without a war.
adventures.hook: A goblin scrivener hires the party to register a claim no one else will touch: the safe route to the spire's heart.
adventures.villain: Korsk the Hexer, who wants the waygate opened by blood and force, and the Last Warden who bars the way.
adventures.setting: The boomtown at the spire's base, the goblin-held scaffolds, and the sundered dwarven halls within.
adventures.playerStakes: If the factions reach the waygate first, the frontier burns in a claims-war; if Korsk does, the goblins are blamed and slaughtered.
adventures.encounters: A claims-office brawl; a scaffold chase with the Spit-Crag clan; the cold upper galleries and their winter wolf; the Last Warden and the dormant gate.
adventures.climax: At the waygate, the party must answer the Warden's maker's-word (earned from Thora or the warm runes) while holding off Korsk's coup — and decide who, if anyone, controls the open gate.
adventures.resolution: The frontier becomes a thriving crossroads under a brokered peace, a single faction's monopoly, or a closed gate and an uneasy status quo — the party's call.

quests.name: The Safe Route
quests.description: Broker passage to the spire's heart and reopen the dormant waygate before a claims-war erupts.
objectives: Register Pib's claim and win Chief Snagga's trust
Earn the maker's-word from Thora or the warm runes
Reach the waygate and answer the Last Warden
Decide who controls the open gate

quests.name: Three Inks, One Sign
quests.description: Keep the three prospector factions from open war over the claim board.
objectives: Hear out Thora, Vell, and the free prospectors

quests.name: The Hexer's Coup
quests.description: Stop Korsk from seizing the waygate by blood before the goblins are blamed.
objectives: Learn Korsk's plan from the Spit-Crag gossips
Cut off his ritual at the heart of the spire

entries.text: A claim dispute turns to fists — a pair of thugs, and a crowd taking bets.
Spit-Crag goblin minions running a (mostly) honest toll on a scaffold ladder.
Vell Brightcoin 'just happens' to offer the party a very generous contract.
A warm dwarven rune glows on a hidden door — a shortcut, if read right.
Pib, breathless, with news that changes everything (and a form to sign).
Goblin warriors of a rival faction, willing to talk if you're funny enough.
The cold upper gallery; a winter wolf paces the broken catwalk.
A hobgoblin captain — Korsk's hired muscle — guarding a stair.
A sundered hall where skeleton wardens still stand their dead posts.
The Last Warden at the waygate, demanding the maker's-word.
